facts.fact: ST Digital launched its Cloud & Datacenter Services in Cameroon, a data centre offering colocation, rack rental, hosting and cloud to outside customers; the article (published 2021-01-28) gives no separate launch date.

ST Digital states its Cloud & Datacenter Services facility in Cameroon is of Tier 3 design with 98.8% availability (operator's own statement; no Uptime Institute certification mentioned); article published 2021-01-28.
